company.name: One Degree
company.shortDescription: One Degree is a nonprofit technology-driven organization that is revolutionizing the way low-income families access community resources.
company.description: One Degree provides a technology platform and service suite that helps individuals connect with nonprofit, government, and community resources. The company operates a web and mobile resource directory that enables users to search, review, and manage social services such as housing, food support, healthcare, job training, and benefits. It offers infrastructure solutions (e.g. closed-loop referral systems, data tracking, screening tools) to organizations like social service agencies, healthcare providers, and government bodies to coordinate care across systems. One Degree maintains a community access layer so users can freely explore resources, while offering enterprise modules that integrate workflows, reporting, and referrals for partner institutions.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Grant round raised $1,700,000, or 93.41% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Meaningful non-dilutive funding
insights.statement: 2 disclosed grants total $1,820,000, representing 100% of reported funding.
insights.implication: The grants reduce the share of reported financing attributed to equity or notes, although their restrictions and milestone requirements need separate verification.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $1,465,729 to $9,293,746, a 6.34x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 17 (-5 over 90 days) and market heat at 56 (-33).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include Unite Us, Socially Determined, NowPow.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
